title: The Xishuangbanna Declaration ATBC 2026 “Building Partnerships for Ecological Resilience and Long‐Term Sustainability in Tropical Asia”
content: The Xishuangbanna Declaration, issued at the 62nd Annual Meeting of the Association for Tropical Biology and Conservation (ATBC) held in Xishuangbanna, China, June 28–July 3rd 2026, builds on the 2006 Kunming Declaration to renew conservation priorities for tropical Asia. Marking two decades since the first ATBC conference in China, the declaration reviews regional progress and establishes a forward-looking agenda. The meeting was hosted by Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS), with support from ATBC, and was attended by over 700 participants, including regional scientists, students, policymakers, and practitioners.
